description: Tests one live link's X card, the free X card tester: robots.txt asked first, so a page closed to mttr is not fetched; then its twitter: tags against what X's archived card docs list (one twitter:card, the site, title, image and its size, and for a player card an https twitter:player with its width and height, and no twitter:player:stream), whether robots.txt keeps Twitterbot out, and for a player card the player route's own headers, read for whether frame-ancestors and X-Frame-Options let x.com, twitter.com and their subdomains frame it. Fetched as mttr, never as X's crawler: X may be served differently, so the reply carries the curl lines to fetch both as Twitterbot. X's player card policy reserves player cards for linear audio and video.

url.description: The link to be posted, as a full public address such as https://example.com/in-post.

name: mttr_x_card
title: Test an X card
